headline: Senior Product Manager | Fintech & E-commerce Specialist
summary: Results-driven Product Management professional with over 12 years of experience in the Nepal tech ecosystem. Proven track record of scaling digital products at F1Soft and Daraz Nepal. Expert in lifecycle management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven strategy for high-growth consumer platforms.

experiences.title: Senior Product Manager
description: Lead the product vision and roadmap for Fonepay's merchant ecosystem, serving over 500,000 active merchants across Nepal.
Conceptualized and launched the 'Fonepay Business' app, resulting in a 45% increase in merchant engagement and self-service onboarding.
Directed a cross-functional team of 20 engineers, designers, and marketers to implement interoperable QR payment standards.
Optimized the merchant settlement engine, reducing processing time from T+2 to T+0 for selected tiers.

experiences.title: Product Manager
description: Managed the localized rollout of the 'Daraz Express' logistics platform in Nepal, achieving a 20% reduction in last-mile delivery errors.
Collaborated with regional product leads in Pakistan and Bangladesh to adapt the Seller Center features for the unique needs of the Nepal SME market.
Launched the 'Daraz Gems' loyalty program, which drove a 12% improvement in user retention over the first six months.
Analyzed user behavior data to redesign the checkout flow, leading to a 5% increase in conversion rate for mobile app users.

experiences.title: Associate Product Manager
description: Managed the development of high-performance mobile applications for international and domestic clients, overseeing projects from discovery to deployment.
Authored over 50 comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and wireframed complex user journeys using Balsamiq and Figma.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives for three concurrent development squads.

experiences.title: Business Analyst
description: Gathered technical requirements for open-data projects and aid-tracking platforms used by international development organizations in Nepal.
Conducted user acceptance testing (UAT) and managed client communication to ensure project milestones were met on schedule.
